newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA SEIZES 45 KG OF HEROIN.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA SEIZES 45 KG OF HEROIN.

text.p: Bulgarian customs officers on Wednesday seized 45 kg (99 lbs) of heroin hidden in a passenger bus travelling to Prague on the Kalotina border checkpoint with Yugoslavia, a customs official said.
"Some 45 kg were found in a bus with Bulgarian registration," a customs official told Reuters by telephone from the Kalotina border checkpoint.
Bulgarian customs have seized a total of 14.3 tonnes of drugs this year along the so-called Balkan route, a major east-west drug trafficking thoroughfare.
